name: donut
author: TheWover, jm33-ng
comment: Convert a Windows PE into position-independent Donut shellcode

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Windows PE (EXE/DLL) to convert (C2 local path)

parameters.name: entropy
parameters.description: Entropy: 1 none, 2 random names, 3 random names and encryption

parameters.name: bypass
parameters.description: AMSI/WLDP: 1 none, 2 abort on failure, 3 continue

parameters.name: decoy
parameters.description: Decoy module for module overloading (optional, C2 local path)

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Command-line parameters passed to the payload (optional)

parameters.name: run-thread
parameters.description: Run the entrypoint in a new thread

parameters.name: exit
parameters.description: Loader exit behaviour: 1 thread, 2 process, 3 block
